```{r,echo=FALSE}
while(T){
    old = sample(1:400,1)
    new = sample(1:400,1)
    sf = new/old
    pc = abs(sf-1)*100
    if(pc%%1==0 && pc!=0 && pc<100 && pc!=50){break}
}
if(new>old){
    ID = "increase"
} else {
    ID = "decrease"
}
unk = sample(1:3,1)
nums = paste0(c(old,new,pc))
ans = nums[unk]
nums[unk] = "x"

```

Question
========

* Old price = $`r nums[1]`
* New price = $`r nums[2]`
* Percent `r ID` = `r nums[3]`\%

Find x.

Solution
========

$$i=`r nums[1]`$$


One way or another it'll be helpful to find the scale factor. If both prices are known, use $s=\frac{}{}$
